Designed for useful answers

Know what's happening inside your bike.

A straightforward way to see what your motorcycle's ECU reports, without unnecessary complexity.

01 / LIVE DATA

Real-time ECU readings

View RPM, engine temperature, voltage and other supported sensor readings in a clear dashboard.

02 / DIAGNOSTICS

Fault-code information

Read reported diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) and see explanations that help guide further checks.

03 / ECU DETAILS

Connection and ECU information

Connect using a compatible Bluetooth OBD-II adapter and inspect available ECU identification and session information.

What you need.

In addition to your Android phone and supported motorcycle, a compatible diagnostic connection is required.

Bluetooth OBD-II adapter

Example of an OBD-II Bluetooth reader. Appearance alone does not guarantee compatibility; not every ELM327-type device works identically.

Motorcycle diagnostic adapter cable

A suitable cable connects the motorcycle's diagnostic port to the OBD-II reader. Verify connector type and pinout before use.

Compatibility: LS410 ECU Reader is developed for the Royal Enfield Himalayan 411 BS6. Verify your bike, diagnostic cable and Bluetooth adapter before connecting. The photographs are examples, not a universal compatibility guarantee.
Why this app exists

Built by a rider, for riders.

“I ride a Royal Enfield Himalayan 411 BS6. I wanted to understand what my motorcycle was telling me, using a practical tool I could carry in my pocket. LS410 ECU Reader grew from that experience — and from the idea that other riders might find it useful too.”

This is an independent enthusiast project, not an official Royal Enfield product. The app is designed for diagnostic reading and monitoring, not ECU tuning.
